questionText:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Both emerge simultaneously on the same flower
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Tassel
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: Silk emerges 10 days before tassel (Protogyny)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Maize is protandrous; terminal tassels shed pollen 2-4 days before lateral ear silks become receptive, promoting extensive cross-pollination (allogamy).
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

questionText: [Set 37.25] In wetland puddle rice (paddy) cultivation, maintaining a continuous shallow standing water depth of 2 to 5 cm during the critical tillering stage is beneficial because it:

options.text: Accelerates soil erosion and nutrient leaching
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Suppresses weed germination and maintains uniform soil microclimate
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Rice Cultivation Water Management.

options.text: Eliminates the need for nitrogen fertilizers completely
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Induces floral sterility and fungal blight
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Crop Production (Rice Cultivation Water Management):
Suppresses weed germination and maintains uniform soil microclimate

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Agriculture (Agronomy of Major Cereal Crops - Rice Cultivation Water Management):
Puddling and maintaining a 2-5 cm water layer in rice fields creates anaerobic conditions that suppress weed seed germination and reduce deep percolation, conserving soil moisture during vegetative tillering.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
